identity.title: King and Queen of the Mirage Kingdom

leadText:
and ]]

The King and Queen of the Mirage Kingdom are the rulers of the Mirage Kingdom, and also Princess Sara's parents. They appeared in The Princess and the Togepi and A Togepi Mirage!.

In The Princess and the Togepi, confronted Princess Sara, her parents, and , who had her in their possession. The King quickly realized that the theft of Misty's Togepi was a part of a bigger plot by Colonel Hansen, and sincerely apologized for the disruption. He instructed Miranda to prepare an airship to escort and from the Mirage Kingdom.

In A Togepi Mirage!, Colonel Hansen kidnapped Misty's Togepi, locked the King and Queen away in the dungeon, and ascended to the throne. However, , , and Misty's newly-evolved eventually defeated Hansen, and the monarchs were released. Because of Hansen’s treason to his country and the royal family, The King ordered Hansen to be arrested.
